description: Render one of the Open Graph templates as a PNG and a Next.js opengraph-image.tsx file. Pass a template id from list_og_templates, the fields that template uses, colors, a size, and optional base64 images.

after.description: After image as base64, a data URI, or a public URL.

avatar.description: Portrait image as base64, a data URI, or a public URL.

before.description: Before image as base64, a data URI, or a public URL.

brand.description: Brand name shown on templates that have a brand row.

hero.description: Hero image as base64, a data URI, or a public URL.

imageUrl.description: Public URL written into og:image. This does not fetch the file.

logo.description: Logo image as base64, a data URI, or a public URL. Private addresses are refused. 10 MB cap.

versions.description: One version per line, as v2.3 | Note.

name: build_open_graph
title: Build an Open Graph card
